item.title: Hello World
item.description:
Welcome to the CodeBass blog.

I have decided to start putting my thoughts out there.

My name is Edward Rixon. I have been a software developer since 2015. I have worked in a few consultancies, and a tech startup. I live in London with my wife, Eloise. As of today, I have been job searching for the last 5 months.

Apart from tech, my main thing is calisthenics, having trained since 2020.
